sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amanur Rahman,Iqbal Ahmad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that co accused Sukhdev with the same allegations
was enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 21.6.2024, hence the applicant having no
criminal history and is in custody since 22.2.2024 may also be enlarged on bail on the ground of
parity.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not deny the ground of parity.

4. Considering the reasonings recorded in the bail order of the co accused (Sukhdev) coupled with the fact that the allegations against the applicant are similar to the co accused who has been granted Arjun vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Arjun vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166622875/
1 bail by this Court and the applicant having no criminal history and languishing in jail since 22.2.2024, is entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
5.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Arjun be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.26 of 2024, under Sections 354 (B), 323, 506, 376(D) I.P.C., Police Station Tulsipur, District Balrampur on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Shukla  Arjun vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
